description: Source review for a bounded auditory attention-flexibility starter derived from Attention Training Technique literature. Reviewed status applies only to the simplified public drill and its explicit evidence boundary; it does not make the page Metacognitive Therapy or a clinical treatment.

refocus-present-stop-mind-wandering.note: Reviewed against 2016 and 2026 systematic-review literature on Attention Training Technique plus a 2021 randomized experimental study reporting no ATT advantage over control on worry outcomes in probable GAD. Public content is limited to the directly described attention operations: external selection, deliberate switching, and broadening/divided attention. It makes no treatment or symptom-reduction promise.

refocus-present-stop-mind-wandering.reason: The reviewed drill practices voluntary attention selection and switching while asking the user to observe control of attention rather than symptom change. Attention & Focus and Metacognition are the concrete Topics; Metacognitive Therapy-derived records the source tradition without implying delivery of MCT.
